title: Immersive Deepslate mod
body:
![Title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/31aceffe013403821b9448f3951755904d4d8863.png)

The Immersive Deepslate mod - is a Vanilla+ mod that adds a unique way to obtain Reinforced Deepslate through an immersive method rather than the standard crafting recipe.

To obtain Reinforced Deepslate, you need to:
1) Place a Deepslate (not Cobbled Deepslate) so that there is an empty block underneath it.
2) Place soul sand on the floor and set it on fire.
3) Wait until the block melts, then use SHIFT + right-click to hit the Deepslate with a Bone Block.
4) Then, right-click the block three times to break it, after which you will obtain Reinforced Deepslate.

Additionally:
If you smelt Reinforced Deepslate in a Blast Furnace, you can obtain a Sculk Catalyst. An achievement has also been added for obtaining Reinforced Deepslate, featuring a unique sound effect.
